ne6f88a2ba8.headline: UK house prices likely to rise by 2%-4% in 2025, Nationwide says
ne6f88a2ba8.summary: Nationwide expects British house prices to increase next year as borrowing costs and affordability constraints ease, despite higher home purchase taxes taking effect from April.
ne6f88a2ba8.why: UK house prices influence mortgage lending, household wealth and consumer spending, and they feed into the outlook for the Bank of England and UK banks.

nd92487b415.headline: Royal Mail takeover by Czech billionaire given green light by Government
nd92487b415.summary: The UK government has given the green light to a takeover of Royal Mail by Czech billionaire Daniel Křetínský. Ofcom's chief executive questioned what the service needs to be.
nd92487b415.why: Royal Mail, owned by International Distribution Services, is Britain's main postal operator, and ownership changes affect its strategy and investor returns.

nb5896445aa.headline: Disaster Insurance Set to Test Italy's Business Backbone in 2025
nb5896445aa.summary: Italian companies are preparing to comply with a requirement to hold natural disaster insurance from next April, though some fear it will be hard to meet.
nb5896445aa.why: Mandatory catastrophe insurance raises operating costs for businesses and shifts risk exposure, affecting the insurance and corporate sectors.

na39170f4e6.headline: Private sector hiring falls at fastest rate in nearly four years after Budget
na39170f4e6.summary: Businesses said rising employment costs and falling confidence were making it harder to recruit new staff following the Budget. Private sector hiring fell at the fastest rate in nearly four years.
na39170f4e6.why: Hiring and employment costs are key indicators of labour-market strength and consumer spending, which shape UK growth, inflation and Bank of England policy expectations.

nbcec6ba1d3.headline: Nigeria’s inflation rate rises to 34.6% as prices of yam, rice surge
nbcec6ba1d3.summary: The National Bureau of Statistics said inflation rose to 34.6% in November from 33.8% in October. Prices of yam and rice rose sharply.
nbcec6ba1d3.why: Inflation data guides central bank rate decisions and drives naira and local bond pricing for Nigeria.

n2fb1d9f4c6.headline: Fifth successive cut: SBP reduces key policy rate by 200bps, takes it to 13%
n2fb1d9f4c6.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan reduced its key policy rate by 200 basis points to 13%, its fifth successive cut. The development was in line with analysts' expectations.
n2fb1d9f4c6.why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets the country's benchmark policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, inflation expectations, and the outlook for the rupee and local equities.
n2fb1d9f4c6.why_moved: The cut is the fifth successive reduction and lowers the benchmark rate by 200 basis points, which is in line with analysts' expectations.

n3f7d94f890.headline: Country Focus: Brazil
n3f7d94f890.summary: Brazil is seeking to become self-sufficient in wheat over the next decade, according to a world-grain.com country focus. The aim reflects reliance on wheat imports.
n3f7d94f890.why: Brazil is a major global agricultural producer, and wheat import needs affect global grain trade flows.

na12390171e.headline: Government approve Daniel Kretinsky Royal Mail takeover - what it means
na12390171e.summary: The British government has approved the takeover of Royal Mail by Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky. The approval clears the deal for the postal operator.
na12390171e.why: Royal Mail is the UK's main postal operator, owned by International Distribution Services. Government approval matters for investors because it governs control of a strategically important, heavily regulated service.

nc78ac6f592.headline: 'ECG's governance is in a very bad' — Mahama raises alarm over ECG's 32% losses, calls for urgent reform
nc78ac6f592.summary: President-elect John Dramani Mahama raised concerns about governance at the Electricity Company of Ghana. He cited commercial and technical losses exceeding 32% and called for urgent reform.
nc78ac6f592.why: The Electricity Company of Ghana is the state utility distributing power in Ghana. Losses at state power utilities affect public finances and energy sector stability.

n5612bb0421.headline: EU adopts 15th sanctions package against Russia for its continued illegal war against Ukraine
n5612bb0421.summary: The Council adopted a 15th sanctions package against Russia, focused on the shadow fleet and sanctions circumvention. It adds listings tied to Russia's military-industrial complex.
n5612bb0421.why: EU sanctions restrict trade, finance and shipping involving Russia. Shadow fleet measures target tankers used to move Russian oil outside normal channels.

n1927545ffa.headline: Palestinian economy facing unprecedented crisis: World Bank
n1927545ffa.summary: The World Bank said the war is having a catastrophic impact on the Palestinian economy, with Gaza output falling 86% and West Bank output 23% in the first half of the year.
n1927545ffa.why: The World Bank tracks economic output in developing economies, and the Palestinian economy's contraction affects aid flows, employment and regional stability.

n57f5e5509c.headline: Minority raises concerns over government
n57f5e5509c.summary: Ghana's Minority Leader in Parliament, Cassiel Ato Forson, expressed reservations about the government's plan to procure ships for the Ghana Navy at a projected cost of €140 million.
n57f5e5509c.why: Large defence procurement contracts draw on public finances and can affect government borrowing and budget priorities in emerging economies.

nec250722c8.headline: Cat bond Index returns 40% in two years. Investor demand may tighten spreads: Twelve Capital - Artemis.bm
nec250722c8.summary: Specialist manager Twelve Capital highlighted another strong year for catastrophe bonds, citing a 40% return on the Swiss Re cat bond index over two years. It said investor demand may tighten spreads.
nec250722c8.why: Catastrophe bonds transfer natural disaster risk from insurers and governments to capital-market investors, and their returns are often uncorrelated with equities.

na5ee9ea837.headline: Colorado looking to catastrophe bonds for wildfire risk transfer - Artemis.bm
na5ee9ea837.summary: Reports say the US state of Colorado is exploring whether catastrophe bonds could be a suitable risk transfer mechanism to help it deal with wildfire exposure.
na5ee9ea837.why: Catastrophe bonds let governments and insurers shift large disaster losses to capital-market investors in exchange for yield.

n9c57e94f40.headline: SBP due to announce updated monetary policy today
n9c57e94f40.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan is due to announce its updated monetary policy on Monday. The article does not state the expected decision.
n9c57e94f40.why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets the country's benchmark policy rate. Its decisions influence Pakistani bond yields, the rupee and local equities.

nd70e4eaed9.headline: S Korea court begins review of president's impeachment
nd70e4eaed9.summary: A South Korean court has begun reviewing the impeachment of President Yoon Suk Yeol. Law enforcement authorities want Yoon to appear for questioning over his short-lived martial law decree.
nd70e4eaed9.why: Political instability in South Korea can affect investor sentiment toward the won, the KOSPI index and the country's large export sector.

n5287ed64ec.headline: M&A deals rise 13.5% in
n5287ed64ec.summary: India's M&A deal value rose 13.5%. The largest transaction is the merger of Quality Care India and Aster DM Healthcare, valued at $5.08 billion, followed by a deal involving Bharti Enterprises.
n5287ed64ec.why: Aster DM Healthcare is a listed Indian hospital operator, and large mergers can reshape its ownership and growth prospects.

n18680c586d.headline: Singapore's Wee Hur to sell Aussie student housing portfolio for $1 billion
n18680c586d.summary: Singapore-based Wee Hur Holdings said it will sell its student accommodation portfolio in Australia to real estate asset manager Greystar for a gross price of about $1 billion.
n18680c586d.why: Wee Hur is a Singapore real estate investment manager, and large asset sales like this reflect capital rotation in property markets.

nd3a8ec6841.headline: London Stock Exchange Suffers Biggest Exodus in 15 years
nd3a8ec6841.summary: Former LSEG head Xavier Rolet said London's flagship bourse has become deeply uncompetitive. He warned of a real threat of more UK firms listing overseas amid the biggest exodus since the financial crisis.
nd3a8ec6841.why: The London Stock Exchange is the UK's main equity market, and listing flows affect liquidity, valuations and the depth of the UK capital markets.

impacts.why: Companies leaving London listings reduce the pool of UK-listed stocks and trading activity.

nb3b6c9012b.headline: Drama expenditure down to $1.7 billion as high-budget production drops off but SVOD spend grows
nb3b6c9012b.summary: Screen Australia says scripted content spending fell nearly 30% year on year to $1.7 billion, as high-budget international TV and Australian theatrical production declined. SVOD spending grew.
nb3b6c9012b.why: Screen production spending reflects demand from streaming platforms and the health of Australia's creative economy.

n905ed48acb.headline: Sterling ticks up, PMIs show UK price pressures
n905ed48acb.summary: Sterling rose against the dollar and euro on Monday after a business activity survey pointed to rising prices in Britain. Investors also awaited a string of central bank meetings this week.
n905ed48acb.why: Sterling is the currency of the United Kingdom, and PMI surveys give an early read on activity and inflation pressures that shape Bank of England policy expectations.

n177235b99a.headline: Futures tick higher as traders brace for Fed, data-packed week
n177235b99a.summary: U.S. stock index futures gained on Monday as investors looked ahead to an anticipated Federal Reserve interest rate cut later in the week and key data releases.
n177235b99a.why: The Federal Reserve sets U.S. benchmark interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, equity valuations and the dollar. Index futures let traders take positions on expected market direction before the cash market opens.

n054247aa14.headline: France's new PM François Bayrou meets party leaders to form government
n054247aa14.summary: Newly appointed French Prime Minister François Bayrou has begun talks with political leaders to bring together divided political forces and form a new government.
n054247aa14.why: The French government sets fiscal and regulatory policy for the euro area's second-largest economy, so its composition affects budget decisions and bond market sentiment.

na39e600eb2.headline: Investing in regional communities
na39e600eb2.summary: Regional local governments in New South Wales can apply for a share of $50 million in grants for initiatives that promote economic development and job creation.
na39e600eb2.why: State grant programmes fund regional infrastructure and employment projects, shaping local economic activity across Australia's most populous state.

naf0014c9ec.headline: German bonds:  Moderate gains
naf0014c9ec.summary: German government bond prices rallied after losses in the previous week, with the benchmark Euro-Bund futures contract up 0.17 percent to 134.65 points by midday.
naf0014c9ec.why: German Bunds are the benchmark euro-area government bonds, and their yields are a reference for borrowing costs across Europe.

nd3888acca9.headline: Norway's sovereign wealth fund buys stakes in logistics properties
nd3888acca9.summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund said it acquired a portfolio of seven logistics properties across several European countries. The assets will be co-owned by its real estate unit.
nd3888acca9.why: Norway's sovereign wealth fund, which manages the country's oil revenues, is one of the largest investors globally. Its real estate buying signals capital flows into European logistics assets.

na8b3c5b335.headline: SNB lowers threshold factor for sight deposit interest payments
na8b3c5b335.summary: The Swiss National Bank will lower the threshold factor at which it pays interest on sight deposits. The move changes how much interest banks receive on their deposits.
na8b3c5b335.why: The SNB sets Swiss monetary policy and its deposit rules affect bank funding costs and the franc's yield environment.

n289de3f35d.headline: Office leasing demand grows despite POGO ban, says property consultants firm
n289de3f35d.summary: A property consultancy found the Philippine office leasing market still expanded by 4% in 2024, despite the ban on offshore gaming operators.
n289de3f35d.why: Office leasing reflects business demand in Philippine cities, and the POGO ban removed a sizeable tenant base from the property market.

n37005ae4e8.headline: Dangote Refinery exports petrol to African countries, diesel and jet fuels to Europe
n37005ae4e8.summary: The Dangote Refinery has exported premium motor spirit to Cameroon, Angola, Ghana and South Africa. It has also shipped diesel and jet fuel to Europe.
n37005ae4e8.why: Dangote Refinery is a large privately owned refinery in Nigeria whose exports affect regional fuel supply and trade.

nb3dd889eaf.headline: How President-elect Trump’s proposed tariffs could further squeeze West Virginians’ wallets
nb3dd889eaf.summary: Donald Trump's proposed crackdown on foreign manufacturing and higher tariffs on China, Canada and Mexico could affect household costs, according to Mountain State Spotlight.
nb3dd889eaf.why: Tariffs raise import costs and can reshape trade flows between the US and its largest trading partners, affecting companies and currencies exposed to those markets.

nbed160f20d.headline: Many banks increase deposit interest rates in year-end period
nbed160f20d.summary: Many Vietnamese banks adjusted their savings deposit rates in the year-end period, showing clear divergence in their offers. Savings rates have become a focal point for depositors.
nbed160f20d.why: Deposit rates reflect banks' funding costs and liquidity, and they influence credit growth in the banking system.

n5e57789b14.headline: Bank of England set to stay in central bank slow lane and keep rates on hold
n5e57789b14.summary: The Bank of England is expected to keep interest rates on hold this week. It is moving more slowly than central banks in Europe and the United States, and remains alert to UK jobs-market price pressures.
n5e57789b14.why: The Bank of England sets the UK's benchmark interest rate, which influences sterling, gilt yields, and borrowing costs across the economy.

n011927c692.headline: Government debt glut could rock markets in 2025, BIS says
n011927c692.summary: The Bank for International Settlements says the threat of soaring government debt supply destabilising markets has intensified. Claudio Borio urged policymakers to act swiftly to prevent economic damage.
n011927c692.why: The Bank for International Settlements is the central banks' central bank, and its warnings shape global policy debate on sovereign debt and bond market stability.

ne73d336056.headline: Trump's transition team seeks to cut EV support, impose tariffs on battery materials: report
ne73d336056.summary: According to a report, Donald Trump's transition team is seeking to cut off support for electric vehicles and impose tariffs on battery materials. The plans are not yet in effect.
ne73d336056.why: Electric vehicle subsidies and tariffs on battery inputs affect automakers, battery supply chains, and charging investment.

n4389a89944.headline: Germany: Chancellor Olaf Scholz loses vote of confidence
n4389a89944.summary: Chancellor Olaf Scholz lost a vote of confidence, a result the SDP leader wanted. The outcome paves the way for early elections in Germany.
n4389a89944.why: Germany is the euro area's largest economy, so changes in its government and election timing affect fiscal policy and investor sentiment in Europe.

n4e9ea3fe7a.headline: India's MFN tweak: Switzerland signals room for rethinking trade deals
n4e9ea3fe7a.summary: Switzerland revoked India's most favoured nation tax status. Reporting says India now prioritises negotiated trade deals over automatic terms, following a Supreme Court ruling requiring separate notifications.
n4e9ea3fe7a.why: Most favoured nation status gives a trading partner automatic treatment on tariffs and taxes. Changes to it can alter the cost of cross-border trade between the two countries.

n157ac41069.headline: Fourth Tango in Paris to stop right steps?
n157ac41069.summary: France appointed Francois Bayrou as its fourth prime minister in a year. Moody's has downgraded France's debt rating, and he must form a stable government.
n157ac41069.why: Sovereign debt ratings and government stability shape borrowing costs for France and the euro area's second-largest economy.

n8f932ced32.headline: Shell announces major investment in Nigeria’s oil industry after Mobil exit
n8f932ced32.summary: Shell has announced a major investment in Nigeria's Bonga North oilfield, which has potential for 300 million barrels. The project is expected to provide more cash.
n8f932ced32.why: Shell is a global oil major, and Nigeria is a significant West African crude producer where offshore projects affect supply.

n9cca5239d6.headline: South Korean shares at more than two-week high after president impeached
n9cca5239d6.summary: South Korean shares hit a more than two-week high at midday after the president was impeached. The market reaction was reported in a midday market wrap.
n9cca5239d6.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's benchmark equity index, and political events there affect foreign investor sentiment toward Korean stocks and the won.
n9cca5239d6.why_moved: Shares rose to a more than two-week high after the president was impeached, per the midday market report.

nea417de3c5.headline: Indian markets open cautiously ahead of US Fed meeting, Nifty and Sensex decline
nea417de3c5.summary: Indian stock markets opened cautiously on Monday, with the Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex declining slightly.
nea417de3c5.why: The Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex are the main benchmark indices of Indian equities listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange. They reflect sentiment in India's large listed companies.

n1a549ce879.summary: TD Insurance, part of TD Bank group, is seeking C$150 million in reinsurance from capital markets through its debut MMIFS Re Ltd. catastrophe bond series. It would be the first pure Canada risk cat bond.
n1a549ce879.why: Catastrophe bonds transfer insurance risk to capital market investors, and TD Insurance is the insurance arm of Canada's TD Bank group.

ne401a30075.headline: DOH: PhilHealth has sufficient funds
ne401a30075.summary: The Department of Health assured the public that PhilHealth has sufficient funds, despite zero government subsidy for the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. in 2025.
ne401a30075.why: PhilHealth is the state health insurer of the Philippines, and its funding affects public healthcare financing and government budget decisions.

nf3991f09d6.headline: Cross-border tax issue puts local RV businesses in jeopardy, advocates say
nf3991f09d6.summary: A long-standing tax issue is raising concerns among Quebec recreational vehicle dealers and U.S. manufacturers, with some claiming it threatens businesses and jobs.
nf3991f09d6.why: Cross-border tax rules affect trade in vehicles and the profitability of dealers and manufacturers operating between Canada and the United States.

ncca39d9eb4.headline: National home sales continue surging, prices rise amid falling interest rates: CREA
ncca39d9eb4.summary: The Canadian Real Estate Association said national home sales in November rose 26 per cent compared with a year earlier, the second straight month of large year-over-year gains, with prices rising.
ncca39d9eb4.why: The Canadian Real Estate Association tracks national housing activity, and housing sales and prices feed into household wealth, mortgage demand and Bank of Canada policy expectations.

ndc5707c8ff.headline: More than what meets the eye? Bitcoin surges to $100,000 and scientists issue major warning; here
ndc5707c8ff.summary: Bitcoin climbed to $100,000, with commentary from market experts warning about the sudden surge in the most popular cryptocurrency's price.
ndc5707c8ff.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price swings are closely watched as a gauge of risk appetite in digital assets.
ndc5707c8ff.why_moved: The article reports a sudden surge in Bitcoin's price to $100,000, which market experts are cautioning about.

nb6f72e3412.headline: Agro-forestry-fisheries exports top 62 billion USD in 2024
nb6f72e3412.summary: Vietnam's agro-forestry-fisheries exports are projected to exceed $62 billion in 2024 and keep growing next year, a conference in Ho Chi Minh City heard on December 16.
nb6f72e3412.why: Agricultural and seafood exports are a major earner of foreign currency for Vietnam's economy.

n6086fefa4d.headline: Guinness drinkers warned as national shortage causes crisis at UK pubs
n6086fefa4d.summary: Pubs and bars across the UK have begun running out of Guinness after allocation limits were placed on the number of kegs they can receive.
n6086fefa4d.why: Guinness is brewed by Diageo, one of the world's largest spirits and beer companies, so supply constraints affect its UK on-trade sales.

n7edf541766.headline: "At the Heart of the News" - Purchasing power: what actions is the GM taking to relieve consumers?
n7edf541766.summary: Mauritius is considering government actions aimed at lowering prices to relieve consumer purchasing power pressures.
n7edf541766.why: Purchasing power affects consumer spending and economic growth; government measures can influence inflation and market demand.

nea2d6a9ef2.summary: Dixon Technologies and Vivo India announced a joint venture to produce smartphones, with Dixon holding 51% stake.
nea2d6a9ef2.why: Manufacturing partnerships in India support local supply chains and align with government policies on domestic production.

n72b88b61e5.headline: Silvaco Group (SVCO) Shares Crash After Disclosing Delayed Orders And Updating FY 2024 Outlook – Hagens Berman
n72b88b61e5.summary: Silvaco Group (NASDAQ: SVCO) shares fell to their lowest level after the company disclosed delayed orders and updated its fiscal 2024 outlook downward.
n72b88b61e5.why: Silvaco is a semiconductor software company; order delays and outlook cuts can signal sector weakness and affect investor confidence.
